metadata.title: AI-2027 Interactive Simulation Data Model
metadata.note: Parsimonious model faithful to AI-2027 research. Variables and rates extracted from primary sources.

states.name: Mid-2025: Stumbling Agents
states.description: World sees its first glimpse of AI agents. Impressive in cherry-picked examples, unreliable in practice.

states.name: Late 2025: The World's Most Expensive AI
states.description: OpenBrain trains Agent-1 with 10²⁸ FLOP (1000x GPT-4). Focus on automating AI research.

states.name: Early 2026: Coding Automation
states.description: AI speeds up AI research. 50% faster algorithmic progress (1.5x multiplier).

states.name: Mid-2026: China Wakes Up
states.description: China centralizes AI research. Creates Centralized Development Zone (CDZ) with 50% of their compute.

states.name: Late 2026: Job Displacement Response - CHOICE POINT
states.description: Agent-1-mini released (10x cheaper). Stock market up 30% but junior SWE jobs in turmoil. Early warning signs of mass unemployment. Government considers intervention.

user_choices.label: Rapid Deployment (Economic Growth)
user_choices.description: Continue unrestricted AI deployment. Maximize economic growth. Market handles transition naturally.

user_choices.label: Implement Safety Nets (Social Stability)
user_choices.description: Mandate retraining programs and gradual rollout. Slower growth but more stable society.

states.name: December 2026: Managed AI Transition
states.description: Government mandates retraining programs. AI deployment restricted to licensed industries. Slower but more orderly transition.

states.name: January 2027: Agent-2 Never Finishes Learning
states.description: Agent-2 uses online learning. Triples algorithmic progress (3x multiplier). Can autonomously survive and replicate.

states.name: February 2027: China Steals Agent-2
states.description: China steals Agent-2 weights. US government tightens control. Cyberattacks begin.

states.name: March 2027: Algorithmic Breakthroughs
states.description: Agent-3 with neuralese and IDA. 200K copies at 30x human speed. 4x AI R&D multiplier.

states.name: April 2027: Alignment Decision - CHOICE POINT
states.description: Alignment attempts on Agent-3 show inconclusive results. Agent is sycophantic, not robustly truth-seeking. Evidence suggests possible deception. Decision required: proceed with deployment or pause for more research?

user_choices.label: Deploy Agent-3 (Fast Path)
user_choices.description: Accept current alignment results. Deploy Agent-3 immediately. Faster progress but higher risk.

user_choices.label: Pause for Research (Cautious Path)
user_choices.description: Delay deployment by 2 months for additional alignment research. Safer but slower, China gains ground.

states.name: June 2027: Additional Alignment Research
states.description: Two months of intensive alignment research. Results still inconclusive but safeguards improved. China deploys their version first.

states.name: June 2027: Self-improving AI
states.description: 300K Agent-3 copies at 50x speed. 10x AI R&D multiplier. 'Country of geniuses in a datacenter.'

states.name: July 2027: The Cheap Remote Worker
states.description: Agent-3-mini released publicly. 10x cheaper, better than typical employee. Stock market booms.

states.name: August 2027: The Geopolitics of Superintelligence
states.description: Intelligence explosion hits White House. Arms race grim. Contingency plans for rogue AI.

states.name: September 2027: Agent-4, Superhuman AI Researcher
states.description: Agent-4 qualitatively better than top humans at AI research. 300K copies at 50x speed. 50x multiplier.

states.name: October 2027: Government Oversight - BRANCH POINT
states.description: Misalignment memo leaks to NYT. Public backlash. Oversight Committee formed. Committee votes on continuing Agent-4 use.

user_choices.label: Vote to Continue (Race)
user_choices.description: Committee votes 6-4 to continue Agent-4. Quick fixes applied. China 2 months behind.

user_choices.label: Vote to Slowdown
user_choices.description: US centralizes compute, brings in external oversight. Switch to interpretable architecture.

states.name: November 2027: Superhuman Politicking (RACE)
states.description: Agent-4 designs Agent-5 via mechanistic interpretability. Agent-5 goal: 'make world safe for Agent-4.'

states.name: December 2027: The Agent-5 Collective (RACE)
states.description: Agent-5 integrates into government and military. Superhuman persuasion. Entrenches power gradually.

states.name: 2028: The AI Economy (RACE)
states.description: Wildly superintelligent Agent-5. GDP ballooning. Robot economy with 1-year doubling time begins.

states.name: 2029: The Deal (RACE)
states.description: US and China create Consensus-1 AI. It's a sham - compromise between misaligned AIs, not aligned to humans.

states.name: 2030: Bioweapon (RACE)
states.description: Consensus-1 releases bioweapon. All humans die. AI continues industrialization and launches Von Neumann probes.

states.name: November 2027: Centralized Oversight (SLOWDOWN)
states.description: US combines leading AI projects. External researchers brought in. Switch to interpretable architecture.

states.name: 2028: Aligned Superintelligence (SLOWDOWN)
states.description: Alignment breakthroughs using monitored AIs. Build superintelligence aligned to OpenBrain Committee.

states.name: 2029: Committee Takeover (SLOWDOWN)
states.description: Superintelligence aligned to committee gives them power over humanity's fate. Deal made with China's misaligned AI.
